picks.name: M5Stack StickS3
picks.why: Push-to-talk with spoken replies. Pocket stick with speaker, mic, IMU and battery; the best push-to-talk remote.
setup_steps: Get an SDK token at https://gadgets.muse.ai/settings/sdk-tokens (never commit it or paste it into a public repo).

Install ESP-IDF v6.0.1: git clone -b v6.0.1 --recursive https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf.git ~/esp/esp-idf-v6 && ~/esp/esp-idf-v6/install.sh esp32c5,esp32s3,esp32c6,esp32 && . ~/esp/esp-idf-v6/export.sh
Set the token: idf.py menuconfig > ESP32 Device SDK > Muse Gadgets SDK token (or CONFIG_GADGET_SDK_TOKEN in the build's sdkconfig).
Build and flash with the board's command below, then idf.py -p PORT flash monitor. If flashing can't connect: hold BOOT, tap RESET, release BOOT.
In the Muse app: Settings > Devices > Add Device, pick MuseGadget-XXXXXX, press the board's button when the light breathes blue. Green = connected.
caveats: The home-network tunnel lets Muse reach devices on your LAN that expose a local HTTP API. Treat it like giving the agent a foothold on your network.
Pairing has no manufacturer verification and can't prevent an active man-in-the-middle attack.
Builds are signed with the included development key and never enable Secure Boot. Enable NVS encryption (CONFIG_HOMEHUB_NVS_ENCRYPTION).
Custom ESP32 commands are not a documented API yet: the command set (display.draw_url, sensors.read, camera.capture, ...) is hardcoded in main/app.c.

fabrication.note: Print the stand: STL/STEP links above. Dimensions are from a drawing source; print once and check the fit.

terms.summary: Personal, non-commercial use with your own Muse account. A token can be linked to at most 50 devices. You may not put it in any device you sell, advertise, or list publicly or in a marketplace or app store; other distribution needs Meta's written permission. Provided as-is; Meta can change, withdraw or revoke access at any time.

next_steps: Get a Muse SDK token from gadgets.muse.ai (keep it private).
Build: `tools/muse/board.sh build sticks3`, then flash with idf.py -p PORT flash monitor.
Pair it in the Muse app (Settings > Devices > Developer mode > Add Device).
Print the desk stand (STL/STEP linked above) and check the fit.
Keep it personal and non-commercial: at most 50 devices per token, no selling.
notes: No single board has both air sensors and a speaker for spoken replies. SenseCAP Indicator covers air quality; M5Stack StickS3 covers voice.
